title: XANES reference library of sulphur-containing compounds for biological research: a status report from the ASTRA beamline at the SOLARIS National Synchrotron Radiation Centre
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13513-13524
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00682A, Paper
Open Access

Agnieszka Klonecka, Joanna Sławek, Grzegorz Gazdowicz, Alexey Maximenko, Andrzej Sławek, Marcel Piszak, Henning Lichtenberg, Maciej Kozak
XANES spectra of sulphur compounds measured at ASTRA beamline (SOLARIS) support a growing reference library for biological research, enabling detailed insights into sulphur’s roles in medicine, biotech, and environmental studies.
